title: Saul's Disobedience to Amalek
description: Saul spares King Agag and the best of the plunder instead of devoting everything to destruction as God commanded. Samuel declares that obedience is better than sacrifice, and that the Lord has rejected Saul as king. Finally, Samuel himself cuts down Agag in Gilgal.
